I'm feeling really good about this and looking forward to hopefully seeing an improvement in things like my hair and skin.

As someone who also isn't a big fan of food or eating, the reduced food quantity is a blessing. Meals can be a bowl of nuts now which means it doesn't have to be an event that halts my day from more interesting things.

Quit sugar, you guys. Embrace eggs and fat. It's great.

Non-starchy vegetables, yes, but fruits are tricky because they are sugar even though the fiber and nutrient content is quality. Fruit has the potential to spike blood sugar and so moderation applies. I wouldn't tell anyone to avoid fruit on principle, but personally, no, I'm not eating fruit. The nutritional benefits of fruit can be found in very low sugar vegetables so it's not a big loss in my book.

The low carb diet works on fat being the primary energy source. With macros at around 80% fat, that's what most of your food needs to look like. Swapping the fruit I used to have for lunch for peanut butter has made me feel better and more satiated.

Making an observation that interestingly enough, the diet that makes you feel good holistically happens to be very similar to cyclical ketogenic diets, which have been proven to be quite effective for weight loss/management.
